articles.title_en: Plague may have resurfaced in Russia. But this isn’t the Black Death.
articles.lead_en: On October 1, 2026, the inpatient unit at the district hospital in Shelekhov, in Russia’s Irkutsk region, closed because of a suspected “especially dangerous infection.” Media outlets later reported that 28-year-old Darya Shipilova had died there of pneumonic plague. According to one account, she was a laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute and accidentally broke a test tube containing the bacterium that causes the disease.

articles.title_en: India is one of Russia’s biggest energy buyers. Can it also help broker peace with Ukraine?
articles.lead_en: India is beginning to take a more active role in efforts to reach a settlement between Russia and Ukraine, Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar said.
